---
title: Cohort participants to administrative records
---

## Question

How can a cohort be linked to administrative records when only partial identifiers are available for some participants?

## Data

Synthetic cohort and administrative files with realistic duplicates, nicknames, and varying completeness by collection wave.

## Linkage strategy

Start with deterministic passes for the strongest identifiers, then score residual candidates probabilistically.

## Result

The walkthrough demonstrates why partial-identifier linkage needs both transparent exclusions and sensitivity analysis.

## Reporting

Describe partial identifier coverage, residual unmatched participants, and any subgroup patterns in linkage success.
